adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js, both removeMember and addMembers do `return Discourse.ajax(...).then(function() { self.findMembers(); });` (i.e., they trigger a reload but do not `return self.findMembers()` from the `then`). This means the promise returned by removeMember/addMembers resolves without the refreshed members data, so a caller cannot chain on the completion/result of the reload. The duplication of the same ajax-then-reload pattern is also present. However, in this diff the current callers (admin-group controller actions) don't appear to rely on chaining the refreshed data, so it's more of an API/maintainability issue than a demonstrable breakage.
